name: hero-shop-reference-polish
description: Validate cohesive Hero City shop chrome, balanced feature-card geometry, safely framed premium companions, configured purchase controls, authoritative coin purchase, and close behavior.

steps.label: wait for runtime shop assets and regional prices

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local cfg=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.GameConfig) local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local a=g.PunchWallClientAutomation a:Invoke('OpenTab','Fists') a:Invoke('OpenShopPage','Fists') task.wait(.25) local s=g.GameMenu.FunctionalHeroShop local scroll=s:FindFirstChild('FistCatalogScroll') local cards={} for _,item in ipairs(cfg.Fists) do table.insert(cards,s:FindFirstChild(item.name..'ShopCard',true)) end local standard=true local minHeight=999 for _,card in ipairs(cards) do standard=standard and card and card:GetAttribute('ShopCardLayout')=='StandardHalfWidthV2' and card:GetAttribute('CatalogScrollable')==true minHeight=card and math.min(minHeight,card.AbsoluteSize.Y) or 0 end local scrollable=scroll and scroll.CanvasSize.Y.Offset>scroll.AbsoluteSize.Y and s:GetAttribute('ShopCatalogScrollMode')=='FixedReadableCardsV1' local result={ok=#cards==#cfg.Fists and #cards==16 and standard and minHeight>=110 and scrollable,cards=#cards,standard=standard,minHeight=minHeight,scrollable=scrollable} assert(result.ok,H:JSONEncode(result)) return true

steps.label: Fists use sixteen readable cards in a scrollable catalog

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local cfg=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.GameConfig) local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local a=g.PunchWallClientAutomation a:Invoke('OpenShopPage','Premium') task.wait(.35) local s=g.GameMenu.FunctionalHeroShop local cards,preview,configured,wired,fit,priceClean=0,0,0,0,0,0 local first,last for index,pet in ipairs(cfg.PremiumPets) do local card=s:FindFirstChild(pet.name..'ShopCard') local action=card and card:FindFirstChild(pet.name..'Action',true) local viewport=card and card:FindFirstChild('PremiumPetPreview',true) local price=card and card:FindFirstChild('Price',true) if card then cards+=1 first=first or card last=card end if card and card:GetAttribute('PremiumPetPreviewReady')==true then preview+=1 end if viewport and viewport:GetAttribute('PreviewFit')=='BoundingSphereSafeV2' then fit+=1 end if price and not string.find(price.Text,'R$',1,true) then priceClean+=1 end if action and action.Active and action.Selectable and action:GetAttribute('PurchaseConfigured')==true and action:GetAttribute('GamePassId')==pet.gamePassId then configured+=1 end if action and action:GetAttribute('ShopActionBound')==true then wired+=1 end end local feature=first and last and first:GetAttribute('ShopCardLayout')=='StandardHalfWidthV2' and last:GetAttribute('ShopCardLayout')=='FeaturedFullWidthV2' and last.AbsoluteSize.X>first.AbsoluteSize.X*1.95 and math.abs(last.AbsolutePosition.X-first.AbsolutePosition.X)<=3 local result={ok=cards==3 and preview==3 and fit==3 and configured==3 and wired==3 and priceClean==3 and feature,cards=cards,preview=preview,fit=fit,configured=configured,wired=wired,priceClean=priceClean,feature=feature} assert(result.ok,H:JSONEncode(result)) return true

steps.label: Premium companions use exact previews and configured Game Pass actions

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local a=g.PunchWallClientAutomation a:Invoke('OpenShopPage','Boosts') task.wait(.2) local s=g.GameMenu.FunctionalHeroShop local first=s:FindFirstChild('CoinBoostShopCard') local second=s:FindFirstChild('SpeedBoostShopCard') local last=s:FindFirstChild('DamageBoostShopCard') local standard=first and second and first:GetAttribute('ShopCardLayout')=='StandardHalfWidthV2' and second:GetAttribute('ShopCardLayout')=='StandardHalfWidthV2' and math.abs(first.AbsoluteSize.X-second.AbsoluteSize.X)<=2 local feature=last and last:GetAttribute('ShopCardLayout')=='FeaturedFullWidthV2' and last.AbsoluteSize.X>first.AbsoluteSize.X*1.95 and math.abs(last.AbsolutePosition.X-first.AbsolutePosition.X)<=3 local footer=s.ShopFooter.SecureLabel.Text local result={ok=standard and feature and string.find(footer,'BOOSTS',1,true)~=nil and string.find(footer,'COIN BOOSTS',1,true)==nil,standard=standard,feature=feature,footer=footer} assert(result.ok,H:JSONEncode(result)) return true

steps.label: Boosts use a balanced feature card and truthful footer

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local cfg=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.GameConfig) local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local a=g.PunchWallClientAutomation a:Invoke('OpenShopPage','Robux') task.wait(.35) local s=g.GameMenu.FunctionalHeroShop local cards,configured,widthOk=0,0,true local width for _,product in ipairs(cfg.PremiumProducts) do local card=s:FindFirstChild(product.id..'ShopCard') local action=card and card:FindFirstChild(product.id..'Action',true) if card then cards+=1 width=width or card.AbsoluteSize.X widthOk=widthOk and math.abs(card.AbsoluteSize.X-width)<=2 end if action and action.Active and action.Selectable and action:GetAttribute('PurchaseConfigured')==true and action:GetAttribute('ShopActionBound')==true then configured+=1 end end local result={ok=cards==4 and configured==4 and widthOk,cards=cards,configured=configured,widthOk=widthOk} assert(result.ok,H:JSONEncode(result)) return true

steps.label: Robux cards are equal and wired to configured products

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local a=g.PunchWallClientAutomation a:Invoke('OpenShopPage','Premium') task.wait(.2) local s=g.GameMenu.FunctionalHeroShop local h=s.ShopHeader local f=s.ShopFooter local tabs=0 for _,x in ipairs(s.ShopTabs:GetChildren()) do if x:IsA('TextButton') then tabs+=1 end end local allTextFits=true for _,x in ipairs(s:GetDescendants()) do if (x:IsA('TextLabel') or x:IsA('TextButton')) and x.Visible then allTextFits=allTextFits and x.TextFits end end local chrome=h.Title.Text=='SHOP' and h:FindFirstChild('Subtitle') and h:FindFirstChild('HeaderRedRail') and h:FindFirstChild('HeaderCyanRail') and h:FindFirstChild('CloseShop') and f:FindFirstChild('CloseShopBottom')==nil and f:FindFirstChild('SecureLabel') and f:FindFirstChild('ServerLabel') and s.ShopTabs.PremiumShopTab:FindFirstChild('SelectedRail') local result={ok=chrome~=nil and tabs==4 and allTextFits,chrome=chrome~=nil,tabs=tabs,allTextFits=allTextFits} assert(result.ok,H:JSONEncode(result)) return true

steps.label: header tabs footer and typography form one coherent system

args.code: local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local a=g.PunchWallClientAutomation a:Invoke('OpenShopPage','Fists') task.wait(.2) return a:Invoke('InvokeShopAction','Boxing Glove')

steps.label: invoke visible boxing glove button handler

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local p=game.Players:GetPlayers()[1] local owned=H:JSONDecode(p.RPGStats.OwnedFistsJSON.Value) return H:JSONEncode({ok=p.leaderstats.Coins.Value==320 and p.RPGStats.EquippedFist.Value=='Boxing Glove' and p.RPGStats.FistMultiplier.Value==1.8 and table.find(owned,'Boxing Glove')~=nil,coins=p.leaderstats.Coins.Value,equipped=p.RPGStats.EquippedFist.Value,mult=p.RPGStats.FistMultiplier.Value})

steps.label: close shop through header close handler

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD task.wait(.2) return H:JSONEncode({ok=not g.GameMenu.Visible and not g.HeroShopDimmer.Visible,menu=g.GameMenu.Visible,dimmer=g.HeroShopDimmer.Visible})
